extension.description: Add this repository to Kodi to install Rivulet and receive automatic updates.
extension.news: v1.0.3: - Changed: Kodi now verifies the repository index and every downloaded zip against a SHA-256 digest published beside it, so a truncated or corrupted download is refused instead of installed. - Changed: the icon is now opaque, as the add-on rules require. v1.0.2: - Changed: the new Rivulet ripple logo. The artwork shipped with 0.16.0's rebrand, but a repository addon only refetches its icon when its own version changes - this release exists to carry that change to installed copies.
